record.title: Review the postboot-only observation boundary
record.intent: Admit missing derived observations without repeating the native transition.
requirements: Independently review the immutable stopped capture, exact local report semantics, captured DHCP authority, introduction ownership, source difference, actual frame and negative controls, typed concrete bindings and absence of deployment or reboot in the new controller.

Proceed only with a clear present-state question, verified helper retirement, no duplicate controller and sufficient reserve for final stock restoration. Preserve the old interruption and its missing proofs. Otherwise record a narrow safe restoration question rather than inventing policy or epoch acceptance.
acceptance: A conditional concrete execution boundary or precise stop is recorded.
